notes.title: Wooden Battles 2?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it's been a while!

It has been a while since I made any updates. I apologize for that. Today, I have some news to share.

Initially, I was making regular updates for this game, but as time went on, other things in life came up. I had to prepare for some exams, deal with my professional life, and I also had other game ideas I wanted to explore, so I ended up putting development of this game on hold. I have been meaning to get back to it, but days turned into weeks, weeks into months, and then into years. And here we are.

I always felt that if I could make this game all over again, I would have done things differently. I feel like I have learned a lot as a developer since this game was originally created. I felt like I could do it better. But at the same time, re-making the whole game from scratch would be tiresome. So for a while, I was playing around with it, but wasn't sure where to go with it. It didn't really make sense to recreate the whole game from scratch, and replace this game with it. I thought that maybe a sequel was the right decision. Doing it all from the very beginning again would allow me to plan things better, and add things like vehicles and aircraft to the game.

For the past year and a half or so, I have been experimenting on a sequel to Wooden Battles. I have been making some short videos on my youtube channel showing the progress. I have decided that it's time to make a Steam page, and collect some feedback.

But the thing is, I am not really sure what the community really wants. I have been keeping you all in the dark all these years. So what would you all like to see? Do you think a sequel is the right decision? Any suggestions where to go from here? Let me know your feedback!

Thanks everyone!

SP.

notes.title: Mines and Turrets
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Time for another update.

In this update I am adding mines and a few turret types. They cost "block currency," the same currency you use for blocks and structures. They also work the same way that blocks do, so if you don't have any units left, just the mines and/or turrets, you will lose the battle. I may change that later on, I will see.

Mines work on a proximity basis, when enemy units get near them, the mines explodes dealing AOE damage. I originally was planning to make the mines invisible, and maybe make it so that nearby officer can reveal mines. I may modify how mines work later on.

Turrets are stationary, and have a limited angle of rotation. It means that they can only target units that are in a narrow cone in front of them. There are currently two types of turrets, the Fort Cannon, and the Fort Gun. The Fort Cannon is similar to the ordinary cannon, while the Fort Gun is similar to the Gatling Gun. My original plan was to have the turrets have limited ammo but for now I made them with infinite ammo. I may change that later on.

In the next update I hope to add a way to overwrite the 4 pre-made structures with your own. This feature is already partially implemented in the game, but currently it's disabled. I need to work on it a bit more before I can release it.

I also want to experiment with the idea of a player controlled unit for Conquest Mode. Perhaps some sort of hero unit that can level up and get new weapons and skills. I will see if something like that will work with this game.

That is all for now.

Thanks!

notes.title: Block Materials, Unit Drag Selection, Copy/Paste
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since the last update. I've been busy with some personal things plus I had some difficulties with some of the added features, but here is another update.

First, I'm introducing block materials. Instead of only wooden blocks, there are now rubber and reinforced wood blocks for all types. There are 3 buttons at the top of the block UI that allow you to select the material. Reinforced wooden blocks are the strongest, and also most expensive. Rubber blocks are slightly cheaper and weaker than reinforced blocks, but they bounce back cannon balls. Wooden blocks are the original blocks that were already in the game.

Next, I've added the option to select multiple units at once during the building phase. You will notice that there is a button that says "ISO" next to the play button. This button toggles between top down isometric view, and the normal 3D view. While in ISO mode, you can click and drag with the mouse button to select multiple units. When multiple units are selected you can press the M key to move them, the C key to copy them, and the Delete key to delete them. This works with blocks as well.

I've also added an Autosave option to Conquest Mode. The game will periodically save your progress from time to time, in case you forget to save.

Some bugs have been fixed as well.

That is all for this update.

I'm hoping to add some turrets, and maybe mines in the next update.

Thanks!

notes.title: Conquest Mode, New Factions, Tech Tree
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Hope you are all having a good start to the new year.

A new update for Wooden Battles is here! The Winter Mode is now removed from the game, but there have been some major changes to Conquest Mode.

Conquest Mode now has 2 new factions, Purple, and Teal. The map has been expanded to make room for the new factions.

A tech tree has been added to the game. You will notice that all of your units are now locked, except for the rifleman. You have to unlock them in the tech tree. Each unit also has several upgrade options, and after unlocking all the upgrades, you can unlock weapons for the unit. Currently, the weapons are the same as the ones from challenge mode, but I will modify it later.

To unlock stuff in the tech tree, you use Battle Points. Battle Points are earned by fighting battles. The number of points you get depends on whether you win or lose, whether it's a fort battle, the size of both armies involved, and the disparity between the armies.

To help unlock some units early on, the Neutral faction will now spawn small armies randomly on neutral territories that don't have forts. Once all the neutral areas are gone, they will no longer spawn units. You can battle the neutral armies early on to get some easy Battle Points.

Several bugs have been fixed in this update as well. Sometimes when you encounter an enemy army in Conquest mode, you were only able to Simulate it, clicking Play Battle wouldn't work. That issue should be resolved now. There were some issues with AI and Battle Simulations, these should now be resolved.

Some people had issues with mouse sensitivity on different display resolutions. I made some changes to the way mouse input is handled, so it might fix these issues, but it could create new ones.

There are a few other known bugs that I haven't fixed yet. Sometimes your armies disappear in Conquest Mode, and sometimes the AI would get stuck in their bases. I haven't been able to replicate these consistently yet, but I will try to fix them in the next update.

I'm not sure what I will do in the next update yet. People have suggested I add metal blocks, custom structures, structures to Conquest Mode, new units, turrets and so on. The list is quite big, I'm not sure yet what I will add next, but I will figure something out.

That is it for now, hope you enjoy!

Thanks!

notes.title: Winter Mode Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!

To celebrate the festive season I have prepared a Winter Mode update for the game. There are 6 missions, and upon beating them all, you will unlock a new weapon for the Rifleman. This weapon is temporary and will only last for the duration of the event. The Winter Mode will expire on January 11.

The Horseman unit is still not added to Conquest mode. I've realized that adding this unit will make the old saves obsolete, and since I'm planning a few other changes to conquest mode, I will just release everything in one big update. That update will be released after the winter event is over.

The updated Conquest mode will include an expanded map, 2 new factions, and a tech tree allowing you to unlock units and research upgrades. I may add a few other of the requested features if I am able to complete them in time.

For now that is all. 

Enjoy the holidays!

notes.title: New Unit, The Horseman!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update I am adding the Horseman unit. It is a mounted swordsman who charges towards enemies on his horse, mowing them down. At close range, he uses his sword to perform a melee attack.

This is the first attempt at a cavalry unit, so some tweaks will be needed. The Horseman is currently not available in Conquest mode. I will be adding him to Conquest mode within a week or two, once I tweak him a bit more.

I've have been working on a Christmas themed update, and hope to have that released in about 2-3 weeks.

After that, I will be going back to working on Conquest mode. I will most likely be implementing a tech tree which will allow you to unlock and upgrade your units in Conquest mode. I am also hoping to expand Conquest mode a bit more by adding a new faction, and maybe some neutral armies to spawn around the map.

Thanks!

notes.title: Conquest Mode Updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The Halloween mode has been removed from the game about a week ago. I think it was a pretty successful mode, and people seem to have enjoyed it. I will probably be bringing it back periodically for special occasions.

A few users have created a [url=https://discord.gg/fNBPH4n]Discord[/url]. Feel free to join it.

On to the Conquest Mode updates. The first change is that the main forts have been slightly upgraded. These are the initial forts that everyone starts out with. They are now slightly stronger than the neutral forts.

Damaged forts will now stay damaged for a while until they are fully repaired. In order for a fort to get damaged, you have to lose the fort battle. If you quit, or retreat, the fort will be repaired back to normal instantly. The reason for that is you can abuse the retreat option for easy fort wins.

Factions now have unit preferences. Blue likes Riflemen, Musketeers, and Snipers. Green likes Swordsman, Musketoons, and Medics. Yellow like Rocketman, Grenadiers, and Rocket Artillery, Orange likes Cannons, Mortars, and Gatling Guns. They will still train other units as well, but these units should appear more often in their armies. This adds a bit of variety, and may require you to adjust your tactics depending on who you are fighting.

There is a new faction report button, it just shows you how many forts, armies, and territories each faction controls.

There have also been a few bug fixes, but these changes could have introduced new bugs to the game that I haven't found yet.

In future updates I hope to improve conquest a bit more, as there are still lots of things to add to it.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:

To celebrate the event, I've created a little Halloween Mode in this update. You can find it in the main menu when you launch the game. This mode is a temporary mode only, and will be available until and including Sunday November 4th. I hope you all enjoy it and have a great Halloween.

notes.title: Musketeer and Swordsman Challenges!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update I am adding the Musketeer and Swordsman challenges and weapons. The Musketeer gets a rifle grenade attachment instead of a bayonet. The grenade explodes on impact and deals AoE damage. Currently, the grenade is a one time use only. I might make it re-usable later on. The Swordsman gets a two handed sword that deals AoE damage, and is more effective against blocks.

The challenges may seem a little hard, but if the challenge gives you money to place blocks, you should. Blocks can be used to delay or distract enemy troops. You can also creatively use blocks to get enemies to bunch up.

I've also fixed a few bugs in Conquest Mode. Over the last few updates, I've added a time control feature, you can now pause or increase the speed of the battles.

I'm not quite sure what I will do in the next update. Some suggestions were to add metal blocks, and add some building features, like copy/paste. I've seen suggestions to add turrets and stationary weapons, so I may do that. There have also been lots of suggestions for Conquest Mode, such as captains, upgradable forts, economic management, etc. I will have to decide what to add next.

I've also been experimenting with horses. The horses aren't quire ready yet, but I think cavalry units will be coming to Wooden Battles eventually.

For now that is all.

Thanks!

notes.title: New Update, Conquest Mode!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

In this update I am releasing Conquest Mode. I've been working on this mode for quite some time now, and it is still very much a work in progress. But I think that it is ready for some testing! I will be fixing bugs and adding more to it as we go, but now you have a chance to try it out for yourselves!

The main purpose of Conquest Mode is to add some context to the battles. Now, instead of just defeating an enemy, these battles have an impact on a greater war, which I think makes it more interesting.

Conquest Mode has a lot that need to be explained. If you click on the Tutorial button in the Start Screen, you will now see two tutorials. The Battle Mode is the original tutorial, Conquest mode is a new tutorial. For now it just contains screenshots with text on it. Hopefully, that will explain how it works.

In Conquest Mode your are no longer just in the bedroom, you are free to conquer the entire apartment. The apartment is divided into many areas and some areas contain forts. Initially, most areas and forts are controlled by a Neutral faction. They won't train any units, but their forts are well defended.

There are 5 factions in the apartment, you control the red one. Forts are used to train units and deploy armies. You can only deploy one army per fort. When that army dies, or returns to a fort, you can deploy another one. The enemy AI can deploy as many as they wish.

To train units you need money, to get money you need to capture areas. The more areas you control, the quicker you gain money. To capture an area, move one of your armies into it, and after 30 seconds, you will capture it.

To capture a fort, you need to battle the Garrison that is stationed in that fort, so make sure to bring lots of units.

If you click on one of your forts it will bring up the fort interface. Here you can train units. You will also notice a Barracks and a Garrison row of units. Barracks units are the units that you can deploy, once a unit finish training it goes straight to the Barracks. Garrison units are units that will defend your fort in case of an attack, so make sure to not leave any forts with 0 Garrison. To transfer units from Garrison to Barracks, simply click on the numbers. Clicking on the Queue numbers will remove units from the training Queue, and refund you the money.

To deploy an army from the fort, click on the deploy army, and load up any units you have in your Barracks. Once deployed, a soldier holding a flag will spawn next to your fort. This flagman represents your army.

At the start of the game, all factions are at Peace with one another. After a while, they will start declaring War. You can click on the Diplomacy button to see the current faction status. You can also click on the Peace/War buttons in the Red row to declare War or offer Peace to the other factions. Peace offers have a cool down, so use them wisely.

You can battle enemy armies by moving one of your own armies close to theirs. You will have the option to play the battle out, or just simulate it if you wish. The simulations aren't always accurate, so you could lose a lot of units to a small army.

Make sure to Save your game frequently.

There are still a lot of issues to be ironed out. The AI still needs some work, and everything needs quite a bit of balancing. There are also likely a ton of bugs as well. I tested it quite a bit, but it helps with more people testing.

Use the discussion board to report any bugs and suggestions.

notes.title: New Unit, The Swordsman!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

A new unit is here, the Swordsman. It is a heavily armored melee unit, with a strong close range attack. It doesn't have any ranged weapons, but it can soak up a lot of damage. The units tab was getting crowded, so I split it into two "pages." You have to click on the arrow buttons to scroll through it.

I also increased the cooldown on the Musketeer's melee attack, to make it a little more balanced.

Some people have been having issues with the Grenadiers not throwing grenades. I was not able to consistently replicate this on my computer, but I did notice a few issues with the way I've implemented the animations for the Grenadiers. I've reworked those issues, so it might fix the grenade throwing bug, but I wasn't able to test it myself.

In the next update I hope to release the new Conquest game mode, where the goal is to wipe out all enemy factions, and conquer the whole map. Initially, that game mode will be released in a beta form, as it is still being worked on. I will let you know more about it in the next update, and you can try it for yourselves.

I also plan to add barracks and challenges for the Musketeer and the Swordsman, but for now I want to get more work done on Conquest mode.

That is all for now, thanks!

notes.title: New Unit, The Musketeer!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a while since the last update, but here is a new unit, The Musketeer. Comes with a musket equipped with a bayonet. If enemy units get close enough, he will charge towards them with his bayonet. This is my first attempt at implementing a melee unit, so there are still some things that need to be improved. I am open to any suggestions you may have regarding this unit, or anything else.

I have also fixed a few bugs, but there are still some that need fixing. There is a new section in the forum for bug reports, you can use that to report any bugs you encounter.

I have been working on a new game mode for the game. It will be called Conquest Mode. It is similar to games like Mount & Blade and Total War. There will be a grand map, with several factions. The factions will control forts, train units, battle each other, take over forts and territories. You control one of the factions, and the goal is to conquer the entire map. When your units encounter enemy units, you will go into Battle Mode, which is basically what you have now where you place your units, and watch them battle the enemy.

This game mode is still a work in progress, and should be ready in about 2 months or so. I think it will add more content to the game, and add some context to the battles.

For now that is all, I hope to have another melee unit implemented in the future, with a wider range of attacks.

Thanks!

notes.title: New unit, Rocket Artillery!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update I am introducing a new unit, the Rocket Artillery! It fires 5 rockets at a target, followed by a long reload. It has low accuracy, and low health, but deals lots of damage, and a high cost.

I've added difficulty levels to the Turf Wars game mode. It starts off fairly easy, and and should build up in difficulty. I might need to balance it a little bit.

I've also added 3 new missions to utilize all the new units.

I've made several bug fixes in this update as well.

In the next update I will try to tackle a bug that was in the game from the very beginning. It is when your units won't attack if their target is too high or too low relative to them. This has to do with the animations, so I would need to add some more animations allowing units to aim up/down.

People have been suggesting units with melee abilities. I want to start working on these types of units next. I will see how it goes, and hopefully, the next unit will have a melee attack!

That is all for now.

notes.title: Workshop Support is here!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

In this update I'm introducing Steam Workshop support. You can now share your custom battles on the Steam Workshop.

In order to use the Steam Workshop, you need to have the Steam Client running, and you need to own the game on Steam.

To Upload to the workshop, go to Sandbox mode, create whatever battle you want to create, then click on the Save button at the top. Below the 9 save slots, you will see a "Save To Workshop" button. Clicking that button will bring up a new window in which you can enter the Title and Description of your game. It also automatically generates a Thumbnail for your battle. Clicking on the Thumbnail will generate a new image, from a different camera angle. Once you are ready to upload click on the Upload button. You should see a box that says "Uploading" and if the upload is successful you will see a box that says "Success."

To Download a file from the workshop you first need to subscribe to that file. Currently, there is no way to subscribe from within the game, so you have to go to the Workshop Tab on the store page, and subscribe to items manually. Once you subscribed to some items, launch the game, go into Sandbox mode and click load. In the load window there is a new button called "Load From Workshop." Clicking that button will display the items you are currently subscribed to. Click the Load button to load the file into the game.

That's all I have for this update, and it took quite a while to get everything sorted. I hope to expand on the Workshop in the future, adding Custom Units and Custom Weapons, but for now that's all I have.

Be sure to report any issues and/or suggestions regarding the Workshop.

Thanks!

notes.title: Mortar Unit and Save/Load Functionality
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update I am adding the Mortar Unit, which is a long range unit that deals AOE damage. It only has enough ammo for 5 shots, after using up all its ammo, it will die.

I've also added the option to save and load your custom battles in sandbox mode. There are currently 9 slots available for you to use. I will expand on this a little more in the future.

Some people have suggested that I add the option to share custom battles on Steam Workshop. I think this is a great idea, and I am currently in the process of implementing it. It will take quite a while to set everything up, but as soon as it is ready, I will release it. Once Steam Workshop is implemented, I could also start adding achievements to the game.

This is it for this update, and I hope to have Steam Workshop working soon.

Thanks!

notes.title: New Officer Weapon and Challenges!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

In this update I added a new Officer Weapon, and some Officer challenges. I've made some bug fixes, and added a visual line separating the two halves of the map. I've also added a "Clear Bodies" button, this can be used to clear up some dead bodies to reduce lag a little.

In the next update I hope to add a new Unit, and I will also try to implement some save and load feature.

There is currently a bug where units won't shoot if the target is too high or too low. I know what is causing it, but it will take some time to fix. I hope to have this ready in the next few updates.

Some people have been asking for workshop support. I will start looking into implementing it, I'm not quite sure how it is done yet, but I will figure it out.

That is all for now.

Thanks!

notes.title: The Officer Unit and Barracks are here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since the last update, but I finally have another one ready!

In this update I am introducing a new unit to the game called the Officer. This unit increases the accuracy of nearby Riflemen, Cannons, and Snipers.

I've also added several Barracks structures and a new game mode called Turf Wars that utilizes these structures. Barrack periodically spawn units until they are destroyed. Barracks are available in Sandbox mode, as well as the new Turf Wars mode.

In Turf Wars, the enemy Team gets 4 random Barracks, and a small number of Riflemen. You get a limited number of money to spend on units and structures to try and overcome the enemy. I plan to expand Turf Wars a little more over the next few updates.

That's it for this one!

notes.title: New Blocks and some Pre-Built Towers!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Another update is here. In this update I've added some new blocks and some pre-built wooden towers. You may have noticed that cannons are not able to shoot when behind a block because the blocks are too tall. To fix this I've added "flat" blocks. They are the same as regular blocks, but flatter, allowing cannons to shoot over them. Another new block is the Rubber Block, it is a block made from a bouncy rubber material that bounces off cannon balls back at the attackers. A few pre-built towers have been added to the game, this should allow for quicker and easier base construction.

I hope to expand on the building mechanics in the game over the next few updates. Some people have been suggesting armored blocks, so I will look into that. Comment your suggestions for what other types of blocks you want to see.

That is all for now. Thanks.

notes.title: Gatling Gun and a Grenadier Challenges are here!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

This updates introduces a new unit to the game, the Gatling Gun. It fires 6 shots in quick succession, followed by a long reload time. It is excellent at taking out large groups of infantry.

Grenadier challenges have been added to the game, together with a new grenade. The new grenade is a cluster grenade that explodes into smaller grenades, each of which then explodes dealing small AOE damage.

3 new missions have been added to the game, incorporating the new units.

The Wave Mode now spawns several different waves of units.

You can now change weapons while placing units by clicking the little weapon button next to each unit.

Several bugs have been fixed as well.

That is all for this update.

In the next update I want to focus on adding different types of blocks and some pre-made block structures.

Thanks!

This update took a little longer but it is finally here! Introducing the Grenadier, a grenade throwing unit that deals AOE damage to infantry and cannons. I've also added a new weapon for the Rocketman, as well as some Rocketman challenges to go along with it. In Wave Mode, dead bodies are now cleared before the next wave spawns to reduce lag.

In the next update I hope to improve Wave Mode a bit more by adding more variety to it. Currently there are just Riflemen, I want to add some variety to each wave. I am also currently in the process of implementing aiming animations that should fix the bug where units can't shoot if their target is much higher or lower than they are. That feature isn't ready yet, but should be out in one of the next few updates.

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: New unit placing options!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

You can now drag out a line of units by holding down the right mouse button and dragging. This should make it more convenient to place large amounts of units quickly. When you right click on a placed unit, a little icon will be displayed over the unit, showing you whether it is in offense or defense mode. Clicking on the icon will change its stance. Once you are done editing the unit's stance, press Escape to deselect it. I also added a confirmation prompt when selecting the "Clear Units" option, as some people have been clearing all units by mistake.

That is all for this update. In the next one I will try to deal with the issue of units not being able to target each other if they are on different elevations. A new units should be added within the next few updates as well.

Thank you all!

Hello everyone!

In this update I am introducing a new unit, the Rocketman. He fires a bottle rocket at his enemies that explodes on impact dealing AOE damage. Effective against Cannons.

Medics rate of healing was buffed, and cost reduced. Musketoon cost was also reduced a little. Wooden blocks are now stronger, they should no longer be taken out with a single cannon ball.

In the next few updates I will focus on implementing some better unit placing options, fixing a few bugs, and possibly reworking the Wave Mode. Additional units may also be introduced within the next few updates.

Thank you and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: A few updates.
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

I've released several more updates over the last few days. The updates included changes to some of the missions and challenges to make them more difficult. I did several bug fixes. I changed the amount of money in Sandbox mode to 900,000, so you should be able to build an army as large as your computer can handle.

There were some bugs with wave mode, for some people killing wave 2 wouldn't trigger the next wave/victory condition. I believe I have found and fixed the cause of this issue. If you are still having issues with wave mode please report it in the comments. I will try to figure it out.

I'm getting ready to move on to implementing more features to the game. I am currently in the process of implementing a new unit, I have a few ideas such as a rocket soldier, grenadier, mortar, Gatling gun, officer, and drummer. If you have some ideas for more units, comment them below. I want the units to stay in the colonial age, so I don't think I will be implementing anything too modern/sci-fi.

Cannons still seem to be OP in large numbers, so some of the units will have a bonus against cannons. Once I add a few more units, I can expand the missions and challenges a bit more.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Another Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I've released another update for the game.

Fixed several bugs in Wave Mode, as well as several other bugs. Added some resolution and sound options to the in-game menu. Cannon cost was increased to 900, and health reduced a little. Cannons are pretty strong, especially in large numbers, so I think maybe some kind of anti-cannon unit is in order.

I've seen a bug where the units just run around in circles, ignore enemies, etc. I will try to address this bug in the next update. More bug fixes in the next update, and after that, I will implement better unit placing controls. Things I'm considering are copy paste function, unit formations, toggling defense/offense mode on placed units, and more.

I appreciate everyone for playing the game, and reporting the bugs!

Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, just a quick update. I've seen quite a few people complain that they are unable to quit the game when a battle is playing. There was a bug with the main menu not working while the battle was playing. I've fixed that bug. Now, when you press Escape during a battle, it should bring up the main menu, which has a quit button.

I am working on adding some video and sound options to the game, but it's taking a little longer than I though. You will be able to select video resolution, and adjust music and sound effects volumes separately. I should have this implemented within the next few days.

There seems to be many other bugs in the game, I will be addressing them over the next few weeks. 

I've been reading all the reviews and comments, I want to thank everyone for the feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates.
